# ONSITES High School (HIGHSCHOOL.ME)

> ONSITES High School is a Florida-recognized online private high school based in Miami Tower, Miami, FL. Students anywhere in the world can earn a U.S. High School Diploma online, with rolling enrollment (start any day), 12-month cross-grade learning, and credit transfer of up to 75% from previous schools.

Key facts:

- Four diploma tracks lead to the same U.S. High School Diploma: Standard (24 credits), Honors (24 credits), ACCEL (18 credits, accelerated graduation) and Global Transfer (for students transferring credits from schools abroad).
- Learning is online and self-paced, supported by real teachers, an AI StudyMentor available 24/7 for each subject, and a dedicated parent help desk.
- Optional add-ons: single module courses, single Honors courses, ESOL English courses, and prep courses for AP, PSAT/SAT, PreACT/ACT, CLEP and CTE.
- Personal support: live group learning sessions, 1-on-1 mentoring, and college and career coaching (applications, essays, scholarships).
- Also offered: a Freshman Kit, an Awards Program and a student Ambassador Program.
- Contact: 100 Southeast 2nd Street, Miami Tower, Suite 2000-1005, Miami, FL 33131, USA. Phone: +1-305-404-5125.
- Parents apply and manage enrollment, payments and documents through a parent account; students study through a student account.
